proof_body:
by
  intro R M _ _ _ a b hc x hx
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hc
  have hone : ∀ y : M, u • a • y + v • b • y = y := fun y => by
    rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, ← add_smul, huv, one_smul]
  refine ⟨(v • b • x, u • a • x), ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · change a • v • b • x = 0
    rw [smul_comm a v, ← mul_smul a b, hx, smul_zero]
  · change b • u • a • x = 0
    rw [smul_comm b u, ← mul_smul b a, mul_comm b a, hx, smul_zero]
  · change v • b • x + u • a • x = x
    rw [add_comm, hone]
  · rintro ⟨y, z⟩ ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    change a • y = 0 at h1
    change b • z = 0 at h2
    change y + z = x at h3
    have ey : y = v • b • x := by
      rw [← h3, smul_add, smul_add, h2, smul_zero, add_zero]
      have := hone y
      rw [h1, smul_zero, zero_add] at this
      exact this.symm
    have ez : z = u • a • x := by
      rw [← h3, smul_add, smul_add, h1, smul_zero, zero_add]
      have := hone z
      rw [h2, smul_zero, add_zero] at this
      exact this.symm
    exact Prod.ext ey ez
target_source: ∀ (R M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (a b : R), IsCoprime a b → ∀ x : M, (a * b) • x = 0 → ∃! p : M × M, a • p.1 = 0 ∧ b • p.2 = 0 ∧ p.1 + p.2 = x
